Troubleshooting real-time insurance eligibility verification errors

Hello Support Team, We are writing to request technical assistance regarding the real-time insurance eligibility verification module in our system. Over the past few days, our front desk staff have encountered intermittent connectivity errors and timeout messages when attempting to verify active policy benefits for scheduled patients prior to their arrivals. We have already verified our local internet connection and restarted the workstation terminals without any change in outcome. Could you please investigate whether there are any ongoing clearinghouse synchronization issues affecting our account?
